statement: Specify and independently reproduce the first Q1 portable logical representation for PartitionService retained committed-statement observations: exact signed SQLite 64-bit decimal strings, opaque committed entry identity, typed settled/unsettled/unavailable/unknown outcomes, nullable retained results, and exact positive safe descriptor-epoch equality. A second-language Python decoder must match explicit accepted, refused and comparison vectors plus independent mutated inverse controls. This is a bounded Q1a specification slice; no runtime, HLC full-domain, finite-JSON Call Cell, public service, native Raft u64, or cold-recovery conformance is claimed.

constraints.statement: Normative semantics remain in the established PartitionService committed-outcome and descriptor-epoch owners; the vectors and Python decoder are a language-neutral observation witness, not a new runtime owner.
No src changes, new public wire protocol, same-disk/mixed-node format, Raft rewrite, new persistence store or extension of predecessor correctness/release gates.
Full HLC lexical/locale agreement, Call Cell finite-JSON float canonicalization, native Raft u64 overflow and crash/recovery remain held under their existing semantic owners.
